t: What Ibn Umar told a man to say lying down
a: اللَّهُمَّ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْيَاهَا إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ
p: Allāhumma khalaqta nafsī wa anta tawaffāhā, laka mamātuhā wa maḥyāhā. In aḥyaytahā fa-ḥfaẓhā, wa in amattahā fa-ghfir lahā. Allāhumma innī asʾaluka-l-ʿāfiyah
m: O Allah, You created my soul and You take it. Its death and its life belong to You. If You keep it alive, guard it. If You cause it to die, forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for wellbeing.
